generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
ALL TERMS AND CONDITIONS AS PER TENDER DOCUMENT

Executed in any one Year (for a Continuous Period of 12 Months), the following minimum quantities of Work.A.Concrete (PCC/RCC)-156.00Cum B.Reinforcement TMT Steel-11.19MT C.SBM/BBM/SSM-341.50Cum D.Plastering-3755.00Sqm E.Painting-11062Sqm F.Flooring Vitrified/Granite/Ceramic/Cladding)-794.00Sqm.In support of this, the Tenderer shall furnish Work done Certificate by mentioning the Executed Quantity in one Financial Year duly certified by the Competent Authority not below the Rank of Executive Engineer along with the Technical Bid

Mandatorily satisfactorily completed, as Prime Contractor, at least one Similar Work Similar in nature of work should be RCC Framed structure building of Value of the Work not less than Rs. 79.50 Lakh. In support of this, the Tenderer shall furnish a Certificate duly certified by the Competent Authority not below the Rank of Executive Engineer along with the Technical Bid. Further, the value of the Completed Works of the Previous Years shall be given a Weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the Price Level of 2026 -27.

The tenderer or his identified sub-contractor should possess required valid electrical license for executing building electrification works and should have executed similar works totaling Rs. 5.00 Lakhs in any one year, In support of this, shall furnish a Certificate duly certified by the Competent Authority not below the Rank of Executive Engineer along with the Technical Bid.

Mandatorily registered with the Employees State Insurance Corporation and Employee Provident Fund. In support of this, the Tenderer shall upload Registration certificates and paid challanas from last 3 months along with the Technical Proposal, failing to comply with these Norms will make the Tender liable to Rejection
ALL OTHER DOCUMENTS AS PER TENDER DOCUMENT
PWD CERTIFICATE CLASS III AND ABOVE

The Tenderer shall without fail visit the proposed site and sign the attendance register placed in the proposed construction site and submit the Feasibility report regarding men, material & completion of work to Asst. Manager-Projects GTTC, Bangalore and obtain due acknowledgement for the same on or before 25 - 11 - 2026 up to 17:30 hrs, and upload the acknowledged document along with Technical Bid
Liquid Assets and / or availability of Credit Facilities of no less than Rs. 53.00 Lakh (Credit Lines / Letter of Credit / Certificates from Banks for meeting the Fund Requirement, etc

Achieved in at least two Financial Years a minimum Annual Financial Turnover (Considering in all classes of Civil Engineering Construction Works only) of Rs. 318.00 Lakh. Tenderer should upload scanned statement of Turn over Certificate with UDIN Certified by Chartered Accountant and along with profit and loss statement and face sheet of ITR for the block period 2021 -22 to 2025 -26 compulsorily. Financial Turnover will be considered on Contractor Receipts only.
